title: Yara and the Orbit
author: L. M. Okonkwo
blurb: Ansel Ishikawa, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the jump window closes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
